value.draft: Whether a trial accepts healthy volunteers depends on its specific inclusion criteria. Some trials actively seek healthy volunteers to study the effects of a treatment or medication. Others may only enroll individuals with a particular condition. Review the trial's eligibility requirements to determine if healthy volunteers are allowed. Pay attention to any health-related exclusions or specific criteria that must be met. If the information is unclear, contact the trial sponsor or site contact directly for confirmation. Always ensure you meet all health and safety standards before participating.
